Madhya Pradesh High Court Upholds 14% OBC Reservation

The Madhya Pradesh High Court has dismissed a petition challenging the state's reservation policy, ruling that the existing 14% reservation for Other Backward Classes (OBC) will remain in effect. The court's decision means the 27% OBC reservation previously sought will not be implemented.
